summary.name: Continuwuity
summary.one_liner: Continuwuity is a community-driven Matrix homeserver, a continuation of conduwuit and a fork of Conduit, focused on user experience and new features.
use_cases: Replacing a Discord server with a federated alternative
Hosting private chat for a community
Deploying a lightweight Matrix server in Docker or Kubernetes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Continuwuity as a community-driven Matrix homeserver that is fast, lightweight and open. It is the continuation of conduwuit and a fork of Conduit, focusing on user experience and new features. According to the awesome-selfhosted listing, it is written in Rust and distributed via Docker, Kubernetes and deb packages, under the Apache-2.0 license. The page itself links to a Matrix explainer and a guide on how Matrix works, and offers a page for Discord users. Source is hosted on Forgejo and GitHub.
notable: Continuation of conduwuit and fork of Conduit
Focuses on user experience and new features
Written in Rust, fast and lightweight
Apache-2.0 licensed source on Forgejo and GitHub
caveats: Page text is mostly marketing; detailed feature list and setup requirements are not stated on the page
